text:
Hi Caio,

Appreciate your patience while I was OOO today.  Please find my answers
below in blue.

*Cost*

   - *Can you clarify the cost model if we deploy the solution on customer
   environment. Is per user/license, per CPU/license, etc? Is that possible to
   share the list price?*
   Encord pricing can be broken down into two parts:
   1. *A standard yearly platform fee. * The platform fee is dependent on
   your deployment type (cloud or private VPC) and type of plan (likely
   enterprise).  I'll need to know your desired deployment, user count, term
   length and if you have specific support needs (custom UIs etc.), to give an
   accurate number.
   2. *A yearly user fee or hourly consumption cost.*  We provide two
   options, with the consumption model being much more cost efficient if you
   are working with freelance annotators.
   - Users / Seats.  Each user is $2000 per year.
